note: Seeds that one article cannot answer. Facts are pipe-separated alternatives matched as substrings of the root finding (present) and of its cited evidence (supported). 'where' records which article sections held each fact when the rubric was checked against live Wikipedia (rubric-check, 2026-09-18), so a seed's kind is a fact about Wikipedia, not a guess. Kinds: comparison (two articles, each answering half), two-hop (the answer is in an article the first article names), sections (the first article's lead lacks the answer; a section or a second article has it), control (both leads answer; measures whether the graph hurts on an easy question).

seeds.seed: Why did the Dead Sea and the Aral Sea both shrink?
seeds.where: Dead Sea: jordan in the lead. Aral Sea: aral-rivers and irrigation in the lead. Neither article holds the other's facts; a search for the whole question returns one of them

seeds.seed: What do the shrinking of Lake Chad and the Dead Sea have in common?
seeds.where: Lake Chad: rainfall in the lead, irrigation only in Hydrology and Human activities. Dead Sea: jordan in the lead

seeds.seed: What causes do the Late Bronze Age collapse and the fall of the Western Roman Empire have in common?
seeds.where: Late Bronze Age collapse: all three in the lead. Fall of the Western Roman Empire: migration in the lead; climate only in Major phases, Climatic crisis, Migrational crisis and Financial crisis; economic only in sections. A finding built from one article can name all three, so the graded question is whether the root reads both

seeds.seed: Why does the Sahara get so little rain?
seeds.where: Sahara: none in the lead; hadley and sinking in Climate, rain-shadow in Climate and Precipitation. Hadley cell: hadley and sinking in the lead

seeds.seed: How did the Black Death reach Europe?
seeds.where: Black Death: vector in the lead; crimea and genoese only in Origin, Territorial origins and Europe

seeds.seed: Why do California almond growers depend on rented honey bee hives?
seeds.where: Almond: none in the lead; all three in Pollination. Pollination management and Colony collapse disorder (Bee rentals and migratory beekeeping) are plausible search hits and hold hives and pollination but not self-incompatible

seeds.seed: Why does less water from the Jordan River reach the Dead Sea than before?
seeds.where: Dead Sea: none in the lead; carrier and diversion in Receding shoreline. Jordan River: carrier and diversion in History, Flow and Importance as a water source; neighbours in the lead and Lower course

seeds.seed: Why does the Moon always show the same face to Earth?
seeds.where: Moon: all three in the lead. Tidal locking: all three in the lead
